display_name: 47. 정답 기반 판정 기준(v2)과 기존 후보 재평가

criteria_v2.basis: experiment 46: on QB the FR D_s/QNR (toolbox 1.0 and original-paper variants) rank the ground truth below model outputs, so they cannot veto
criteria_v2.primary_RR: PanCollection RR20; candidate minus same-condition control; seed-mean PSNR > 0, SAM < 0, ERGAS < 0; with 3 seeds also PSNR > 0 in at least 2 of 3 seeds

guards_ground_truth.RR2: RR test scenes degraded once more (dataset Wald operator), GT = RR MS: seed-mean PSNR >= -0.05 dB and SAM <= +0.02 deg
guards_ground_truth.FR_WALD: FR test scenes degraded by the same operator, GT = native FR MS: seed-mean PSNR >= -0.05 dB and SAM <= +0.02 deg
guards_ground_truth.FR_OBS: interior RMSE (DN) of observation(FR output) - FR MS: seed-mean ratio to control <= 1.10

labels.개선: primary passes and all three guards pass
labels.부분 개선: primary passes but a guard fails, or only part of PSNR/SAM/ERGAS improves

criteria_v2.adoption: a baseline-model change additionally requires 3 seeds; single-seed results are labelled with their seed
criteria_v2.new_FR_indices: an FR index may enter decisions only after passing the experiment 46 ground-truth ranking test
criteria_v2.tolerance_reference: experiment 43 C0 seed SD: RR PSNR 0.056 dB, SAM 0.021 deg

protocol.degradation: MS: common/observation.SensorObservation (QB DLPan MTF, x4, phase 2; experiment 3 audit; RR GT reproduces RR MS to 1e-4 DN in experiment 45). PAN: DLPan MTF_PAN (QB GNyq 0.15, 41 taps, replicate) and the same x4 phase-2 sampling. LMS: interp23tap, which reproduces the H5 LMS of RR and FR test scenes exactly (0 DN)
protocol.scenes: RR test 20 and FR test 20; RR scene i and FR scene i are evaluated by the same model call sequence
protocol.precision: FP32 inference, metrics in float64 DN, no clipping

not_included: research/performance 1-28 (different loaders and protocols), 31 (seed46 short run), 32 (10-epoch screen), 34 (no matched control), 37 (W2 gate; no standalone model module), SSAI and variable-scale tracks
